mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "id",proj_nm AS "name",ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate", proj_stat_cd AS "status",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE ctrt_bgn_dt <= make_date(#{year},12,31) AND ctrt_end_dt >= make_date(#{year},1,1) AND proj_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY proj_id
SELECT proj_id AS "projectId",job_cd AS "jobCode",plan_mm AS "planMm" FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY job_cd
SELECT asgn_id FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE proj_id=#{projectId} AND asgn_stat_cd='ACT' ORDER BY asgn_id
